memory_entries.flaw_pattern: Generic mud labor, clay pottery, or fantasy CGI generated when dialogue discusses ancient engineering marvels
memory_entries.lesson_learned: Never let prompt rely on generic adjectives. Anchor first 5 words with exact architectural entity (e.g., carved sandstone monolith, interlocking basalt dovetail joint, bronze clamp in stone mortise). Preemptively armor against human labor and pottery.
first_shot_rules: Focal subject must appear in words 1-5.
Include tangible materials: weathered sandstone, grey granite, interlocking stone joints, architectural survey drawing.
Specify documentary 35mm optical lens cinematography with controlled 5600K high-bay or natural low-sun grazing light.

memory_entries.lesson_learned: Translate intellectual perplexity into physical measurement instruments and tangible laboratory artifacts rather than human faces or cartoonish fantasy.

Strictly faceless perspective.
